name: onAuditLogEntry
description: Fires when an audit log entry is created in a guild. Requires the GUILD_MODERATION intent. Entry fields are read with Zoption{key}.

context.author_id: User ID of whoever performed the action
context.channel_id: Channel ID if the entry targets one, otherwise empty
context.message: Empty. Zoption keys: entryID, action (e.g. Member(Kick)), actionCode, targetID, reason, channelID, automodRuleName

name: onAutomodAction
description: Fires when an auto moderation rule takes action, such as blocking a message. Requires the AUTO_MODERATION_EXECUTION intent. Action fields are read with Zoption{key}.
when: An automod rule blocks or flags content

context.author_id: User ID who triggered the rule
context.channel_id: Channel ID if the action targets one, otherwise empty
context.message: Empty. Zoption keys: ruleID, action (e.g. BlockMessage), triggerType (e.g. Keyword), messageID
context.trigger_message_id: Message ID if the action targets a message

name: onAutomodRuleCreate
description: Fires when an auto moderation rule is created. Requires the AUTO_MODERATION_CONFIGURATION intent. Rule fields are read with Zoption{key}.

context.author_id: User ID who created the rule
context.message: Empty. Zoption keys: ruleID, name, eventType (e.g. MessageSend), trigger, enabled

name: onAutomodRuleDelete
description: Fires when an auto moderation rule is deleted. Requires the AUTO_MODERATION_CONFIGURATION intent. Rule fields are read with Zoption{key}.

context.author_id: User ID who deleted the rule
context.message: Empty. Zoption keys: ruleID, name, eventType (e.g. MessageSend), trigger, enabled

name: onAutomodRuleUpdate
description: Fires when an auto moderation rule is updated. Requires the AUTO_MODERATION_CONFIGURATION intent. Rule fields are read with Zoption{key}.

context.author_id: User ID who updated the rule
context.message: Empty. Zoption keys: ruleID, name, eventType (e.g. MessageSend), trigger, enabled

name: onBanAdd
description: Fires when a user is banned from a guild.

name: onBanRemove
description: Fires when a user's ban is removed from a guild.

name: onBoostAdd
description: Fires when the guild's active boost count increases.
when: Server receives a new Nitro boost

name: onBoostRemove
description: Fires when the guild's active boost count decreases.

name: onBotJoin
description: Fires when the bot joins a new guild while it is online.
when: Bot is added to a server

name: onBotLeave
description: Fires when the bot leaves or is removed from a guild.

name: onChannelCreate
description: Fires when a channel is created in a guild.

name: onChannelDelete
description: Fires when a channel is deleted from a guild.

name: onChannelUpdate
description: Fires when a channel is updated in a guild.

name: onGuildUpdate
description: Fires when guild information is updated.

name: onMemberJoin
description: Fires when a user joins a guild.

name: onMemberLeave
description: Fires when a user leaves or is kicked/banned from a guild.

name: onMemberUpdate
description: Fires when a member's information is updated (nickname, roles, etc.).

name: onMessage
description: Fires when any message is sent in a channel the bot can see.

context.channel_id: Channel ID where message was sent

name: onMessageDelete
description: Fires when a message is deleted.

name: onMessageEdit
description: Fires when a message is edited.

name: onPollVoteAdd
description: Fires when a user votes on a poll. Requires the GUILD_MESSAGE_POLLS intent. Poll fields are read with Zoption{key}.
when: A vote is added to a poll

name: onPollVoteRemove
description: Fires when a user removes their vote from a poll. Requires the GUILD_MESSAGE_POLLS intent. Poll fields are read with Zoption{key}.
when: A vote is removed from a poll

name: onReactionAdd
description: Fires when a reaction is added to a message.

context.trigger_message_id: Message ID that was reacted to

name: onReactionRemove
description: Fires when a reaction is removed from a message.

context.trigger_message_id: Message ID that had reaction removed

name: onRoleCreate
description: Fires when a role is created in a guild.

name: onRoleDelete
description: Fires when a role is deleted from a guild.

name: onRoleUpdate
description: Fires when a role is updated in a guild.

name: onStageInstanceCreate
description: Fires when a stage instance starts. Requires the GUILDS intent. Stage fields are read with Zoption{key}.

context.message: Empty. Zoption keys: topic, privacy (e.g. GuildOnly), discoverable

name: onStageInstanceDelete
description: Fires when a stage instance ends. Requires the GUILDS intent. Stage fields are read with Zoption{key}.

context.message: Empty. Zoption keys: topic, privacy (e.g. GuildOnly), discoverable

name: onStageInstanceUpdate
description: Fires when a stage instance has its topic or privacy level changed. Requires the GUILDS intent. Stage fields are read with Zoption{key}.

context.message: Empty. Zoption keys: topic, privacy (e.g. GuildOnly), discoverable

name: onThreadCreate
description: Fires when a thread is created. Requires the GUILDS intent. Thread fields are read with Zoption{key}.

context.message: Empty. Zoption keys: threadID, name, parentID, type (e.g. PublicThread)

name: onThreadDelete
description: Fires when a thread is deleted. Requires the GUILDS intent. Thread fields are read with Zoption{key}.

context.message: Empty. Zoption keys: parentID, type (e.g. PublicThread)

name: onThreadUpdate
description: Fires when a thread is updated, such as being renamed, archived, or locked. Requires the GUILDS intent. Thread fields are read with Zoption{key}.

context.message: Empty. Zoption keys: threadID, name, parentID, type (e.g. PublicThread)

name: onVoiceStateUpdate
description: Fires when a user joins, leaves, or moves voice channels.
